scope: centered page dialog geometry and scrim
implementation: production OpenTUI frontend built from src/terminal/opentui/
input: isolated PTY; the command characters were sent one at a time and Return as its own key event
fixture: state and data from an isolated verifier run; the loopback provider was not running for these probes

rule.size: 80% of the terminal, capped at 100 columns by 30 rows
rule.fallback: full-screen page below 30 columns or 12 rows
rule.pageRows: dialog rows less 4 chrome rows (header, two rules, hint)

profiles.notes: The dimmed welcome lockup remains visible around the four sides of the panel.
The page hint row covers the dimmed composer's first row; the composer borders remain visible outside the panel.
The panel ends above the composer at this size.

checks: At each size the page panel is centered and its width and height match the 80% rule and the 100x30 cap.
The panel is drawn in #111114 with no rounded border, and the rest of the console in #0b0b0d.
The full-screen scrim dims the console: the footer foreground is #2b2b31 instead of theme.dim #5c5c66.
The 40x20 capture leaves the dimmed welcome lockup visible around the panel.
The default Pi frontend is unchanged; its verifier passed 80x24 in this tree (see pi-80x24/verification.json).
limits: The full scripts/verify-terminal.py sends /settings\r as one write; the OpenTUI input path drops the Return in that burst. These probes send the command characters and Return separately, as a person does.
The probes establish layout, panel color and scrim dimming, not a model turn or the full verifier's interaction groups.
Each compressed capture is a cumulative actual ANSI stream from PTY startup through the opened /settings dialog. Replay it at its recorded dimensions.
